name: The Tūn-Gāst of Oakshaw
detailed_description:
"Do monsters lurk in the darkness, or do they lurk within us?"

The Tūn-Gāst of Oakshaw is a top down 2D pixel art horror-adventure game with Metroidvania-inspired gameplay, interweaved with a rich and flowing episodic narrative.

Imbued in history, steeped in layered mysteries

The Tūn-Gāst of Oakshaw is set against the historically-accurate backdrop of 1744 Georgian England - a time of fear, disease, war - and gin.

Playing as the Faceless, a monster hunter who roams the land in search of supernatural threats to extinguish, you must investigate a series of strange disturbances and unexplained deaths in the rural town of Oakshaw, Cumbria.

But the desperate and destitute people are at the mercy of the parasitic gin craze ravaging the nation - and they don't take kindly to a masked outsider shining a light on secrets that have long been buried.

An episodic approach to storytelling

As you build your investigation throughout this semi-open world environment and use wits to solve puzzles, you must also wrestle with forces that lurk in the darkness - and battle the demons that lurk within.

Chapter One of The Tūn-Gāst of Oakshaw will launch in 2025. This will be followed with additional chapters in future updates.

short_description: The Tūn-Gāst of Oakshaw is a top-down 2D pixel art adventure that casts you as the Faceless, a monster hunter drawn to a string of horrific deaths in a rural town. Set in 1744, against the backdrop of the English gin craze, you must unravel Oakshaw's mysteries and grapple with the true face of evil.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work, throughout. This includes frequent violence and gore, and general mature themes. 

Themes are dark and centre on the everyday horrors of ordinary life in the mid-1700s. Characters, including the player-character, will frequently consume alcohol.
